text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Would it be alright if I stepped off the royal road
and moved into sprinting instead?

Heading into sprints starting from the Senior Class...
That was Daiichi Ruby's decision.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
“—Once today's Rose Stakes is over,
next up is the final crown, the Shuka Sho...”

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
For someone from the "Splendid Clan," heading straight for the Queen Elizabeth II Cup is pretty much a given, right?
And then running in a bunch of huge GⅠs in the Senior Class...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
“Predicting Daiichi Ruby's race rotation?
Isn't it a bit early for that~?”

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Still, it'll probably always have that glamorous feel.
That suits it best, after all—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
âOur pivot to the sprint division
will be announced as soon as the Shuka Sho concludes.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I will have the butler proceed with preparations for the press conference.
That concludes my report.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
choice_data_list: I'll help out the butler too.

text_block_list.text: While they're probably used to choosing venues and managing the schedule, my knowledge as a Trainer should be useful for deciding which reporters to invite.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...The butler is the one to make that decision.
Please feel free to ask him.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
All of the above is for down the road.
I'll explain the details later.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
First, the race right before me...
I will give my all in the Rose Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
To mark the fresh new beginning
that starts right here—
